description: Defines the PacketDroppingTestWriter class, a test utility for simulating packet loss, reordering, blocking, delaying, and bandwidth constraints in QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter
classes.description: A test utility class that simulates packet loss, reordering, blocking, delaying, and bandwidth constraints for QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback when the writer is ready to write packets.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test writer with helper, alarm factory, and callback.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Attempts to write a packet, possibly simulating loss or delay.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the writer is currently blocked.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns the next write location, disabled for zero-copy.

methods.name: ReleaseOldPackets
methods.description: Flushes delayed packets that are due to be sent.

methods.name: SetDelayAlarm
methods.description: Sets the alarm for delayed packet sending.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Callback when the writer becomes writable.

methods.name: set_fake_packet_loss_percentage
methods.description: Sets the percentage of packet loss to simulate.

methods.name: set_fake_drop_first_n_packets
methods.description: Configures dropping the first N packets unconditionally.

methods.name: set_fake_blocked_socket_percentage
methods.description: Sets the percentage of simulated blocked socket conditions.

methods.name: set_fake_reorder_percentage
methods.description: Sets the percentage of packet reordering.

methods.name: set_fake_packet_delay
methods.description: Sets the delay before writing packets.

methods.name: set_max_bandwidth_and_buffer_size
methods.description: Configures bandwidth and buffer size limits for packet delay simulation.

methods.name: set_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the random number generator for reproducibility.

methods.name: ReleaseNextPacket
methods.description: Handles sending the next delayed packet.
